name: CONTEXT_TARGET
description: The concrete codebase area, subsystem, file set, or runtime context that frames the task.
examples: the flaky integration test around user sync
resolution: Fill this with the most specific target you can infer from the user request and current repository context.

name: DONE_CONDITION
description: The explicit stopping condition for the work loop.
examples: all targeted tests pass and the failing nil-path is covered
the compiler builds, the new contract test passes, and no unrelated files changed
resolution: State a concrete, verifiable definition of done tied to tests, build success, or the requested deliverable.

name: SCOPE_ELEMENTS
description: The code, behavior, files, or interfaces that must not be changed while solving the task.
examples: unrelated packages, generated files, and public CLI flags
the stable compiler pipeline outside the bugfix path
resolution: List the boundaries the agent must preserve based on the request, repository rules, and stable interfaces.

name: STABLE_INTERFACE
description: The API, contract, output shape, or workflow that must remain stable after the change.
examples: the optimize JSON response fields consumed by agents
the existing categories and optimize command flags
resolution: Name the interface or contract reviewers should verify did not drift while implementing the task.

name: TASK
description: The primary task statement the agent should solve.
examples: Fix the nil dereference in the optimizer and prove the fix with tests.
Add agent-facing docs for vokuprompt without changing core selection logic.
resolution: Restate the user's request as a precise execution goal, preserving constraints and success criteria.

name: UNIT
description: The smallest useful work unit the agent should iterate over.
examples: one failing test, then the minimal patch, then validation
one contract file or one CLI behavior at a time
resolution: Choose a deterministic work unit that keeps the task incremental and easy to validate.

name: VALIDATION
description: The exact verification command or proof the agent must run and report.
resolution: Provide the real build, test, or lint command that proves the change worked in the current repository.
